meta.source: Extracted from the Figma wireframes (D1–D7, D3b, M1–M7, E1–E9).
notes: Icons (✓, ✕, ⏱, !) are UI, not copy, so they're not in this file.
Values in {braces} are placeholders filled in by the app.

Not in the wireframes yet, drafted from the specs: document.checking, faceMatch.comparing, processing.slow, document.capture.sideLabel, errors.CAMERA_NOT_FOUND, errors.HANDOFF_USED, document.result.failed.reasons (glare, cropped, expired).
Not in the wireframes yet, drafted from spec 02 (R-02.9 – R-02.12): help.*, saveExit.*, privacy.*.

demoBanner.long: DEMO — this is a test site. Please don't upload a real ID document.
demoBanner.short: DEMO — please don't use a real ID

start.title: Verify your identity
start.intro: We're required by law (FICA) to confirm who you are before you can deposit or play. It also keeps your account secure.
requirements: A valid passport, national ID or driver's licence
A device with a camera — your phone works best
Good lighting and a plain background
start.privacy: Your information is sent securely and only used to verify your identity. Full-size photos are never stored.

device.title: How would you like to continue?
device.intro: You'll take a photo of your document and a selfie.

phone.title: Use my phone
phone.description: Recommended — sharper document photos. Scan a QR code to switch.

thisDevice.title: Continue on this computer
thisDevice.description: Use your webcam, or upload photos you already have.

handoff.title: Scan with your phone
steps: Point it at the QR code
Tap the link and follow the steps
handoff.fallback: Can't scan? Continue on this computer instead
handoff.qrAlt: QR code to continue on your phone

expired.title: This code has expired
expired.body: For your security, QR codes only work for {minutes} minutes. Get a new one to carry on — you won't lose your place.

status.title: Continue on your phone
status.intro: Keep this window open — it updates as you go.
status.lostConnection: Lost your phone connection? Show the QR code again

disconnected.label: Phone disconnected
disconnected.body: We'll pick up where you left off. Your photos so far are saved.

select.title: Which document will you use?
select.intro: Make sure it's valid and not expired.

nationalId.title: National ID
nationalId.description: Smart ID card — front and back

capture.title: Photo of document
capture.instruction: Fit the photo page inside the frame. Avoid glare and keep all four corners visible.
capture.cameraAlt: Live camera view with a document outline

blurry.intro: Part of the photo is blurry. Try again with:
tips: The document flat on a dark surface

glare.intro: There's glare on the document. Try again with:
tips: Light from the side, not above

cropped.intro: Part of the document is cut off. Try again with:
tips: All four corners inside the frame
Your phone a little further away

expired.intro: This document looks expired. Please use a valid document.

selfie.title: Take a selfie
selfie.instruction: Remove glasses and hats. Look straight at the camera in good light.
selfie.cameraAlt: Live front camera view with a face guide

prompts.turnLeft: Slowly turn your head to the left
prompts.turnRight: Slowly turn your head to the right

matched.title: It's a match
matched.body: Your selfie matches the photo on your document.

noMatch.title: We couldn't match your selfie
noMatch.intro: This can happen in low light or if part of your face was covered. Try again with:
tips: Your face fully in the oval
Even light on your face, no hats or glasses

phoneDone.title: All done on your phone
phoneDone.body: Go back to your computer to review and submit. You can close this tab.

review.title: Review and submit
review.intro: Check everything looks right before you submit.
review.confirm: I confirm these are my own documents and the photos are of me.
review.confirmRequired: Tick the box to confirm before you submit.

processing.title: Verifying your details
processing.body: This usually takes under a minute. You can leave this page — we'll email you when it's done.
processing.slow: This is taking longer than usual. You can leave this page — we'll email you when it's done.

complete.title: You're verified
complete.body: Thanks — you're all set. You can now deposit and play.

manualReview.title: We'll review this manually
manualReview.body: We couldn't verify you automatically, so someone from our team will check your documents. This usually takes up to {hours} hours. We'll email you when it's done.

CAMERA_DENIED.title: We can't use your camera
CAMERA_DENIED.intro: Camera access is turned off for this site. To take photos here:
steps: Tap the lock icon in your browser's address bar
Come back and tap Try again

CAMERA_NOT_FOUND.title: We can't find a camera
CAMERA_NOT_FOUND.intro: This device doesn't seem to have a camera we can use. You can upload a photo instead, or continue on your phone.

UPLOAD_FAILED.message: Upload didn't finish. Your photo is saved — you don't need to retake it.
UPLOAD_FAILED.hint: Check your connection, then try again.

OFFLINE.banner: You're offline. We'll carry on when you're back.
OFFLINE.body: You can still take your photo. It'll upload automatically when you reconnect.

HANDOFF_USED.title: This link has already been used
HANDOFF_USED.body: For your security, each QR code works once. Go back to your computer and get a new code.

SESSION_TIMEOUT_WARNING.title: Are you still there?
SESSION_TIMEOUT_WARNING.body: For your security, this session will end in {time} because there's been no activity.

SESSION_EXPIRED.title: Your session has expired
SESSION_EXPIRED.body: To keep your information safe, we ended your session after {minutes} minutes of inactivity. Nothing was submitted. Starting again takes about {min}–{max} minutes.

VERIFICATION_REJECTED.title: We couldn't verify your identity
VERIFICATION_REJECTED.body: Your document and selfie didn't pass our checks, so we can't complete verification right now.
nextSteps: Try again with a different document

generic.title: Something went wrong
generic.body: We couldn't complete that step. Please try again.

help.title: Help

faq.q: Why do I need to verify?
faq.a: South African law (FICA) requires us to confirm who you are before you can deposit. It also protects your account.
A valid South African ID book or smart ID card, a passport, or a driver's licence. It must not be expired.
They're only used to check your identity. Full-size photos are never stored, and everything is deleted when your session ends.

help.support: Still stuck? Contact support and we'll help you finish.

saveExit.confirmBody: We'll keep your progress for {minutes} minutes.
saveExit.savedBody: We'll keep this session for {minutes} minutes.

privacy.title: Privacy notice
privacy.demo: This is a demo. Please don't use a real ID document.

sections.heading: What we collect
sections.body: Photos of your ID document and a selfie, and the results of the checks we run on them.

sections.heading: What we keep
sections.body: Full-size photos are never stored. Small preview images are kept only until your session ends, then deleted.

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: Only to verify your identity, as FICA requires. Nothing is used for marketing.

sections.heading: Your rights
sections.body: Under POPIA you can ask what we hold about you and have it corrected or deleted.
